project_portfolio_v2_card_subtitle: New version of my portfolio developed with React and TypeScript.
project_portfolio_v2_project: Recent portfolio fully built to present my projects, skills, and professional identity. Developed with React, TypeScript, and a carefully crafted responsive design.
project_portfolio_v2_constraints: Respecting responsive design, building a clear front-end architecture, and ensuring consistent animations.
project_portfolio_v2_learned: Building a structured React application, managing routing, organising components, and creating a coherent design system.
project_portfolio_v1_card_subtitle: Team-built fitness web application with interactive planning and enhanced accessibility.
project_portfolio_v1_project: Move Up is a fitness web app built as a team of six. The Express backend (with JSON data) was developed by another team member. I worked on integrating the FullCalendar planning system, connecting it to the API, and improving accessibility and UX/UI consistency.
project_portfolio_v1_constraints: Team coordination, integrating a dynamic calendar connected to an Express JSON API, meeting accessibility standards, maintaining a consistent design system, handling interactive UI elements, and setting up agile project organisation with Jira.
project_portfolio_v1_learned: Front-to-back integration with Express, advanced use of FullCalendar, accessible interface design, agile collaboration, ticket management with Jira, and iterative improvement of a shared design system.
project_portfolio_v1_techs: React - JavaScript - FullCalendar - Express.js (JSON API) - HTML - CSS - Accessibility - UX/UI - Jira - Agile
project_dsA11y_card_subtitle: Accessible design system generator with real-time WCAG validation.
project_dsA11y_project: Web application enabling the creation of complete WCAG/RGAA-compliant design systems. The tool automates contrast ratio validation and generates a comprehensive package including tokens, components, documentation, and accessibility guidelines.
project_dsA11y_constraints: Real-time WCAG validation, strict TypeScript architecture, multi-format exports (Figma, React, CSS), FR/EN internationalization, and compliance error prevention.
project_dsA11y_learned: Design system architecture, WCAG contrast validation algorithms, automatic package generation, react-i18next for i18n, and transforming regulatory constraints into productive tools.
about_block_who_text: Currently fully immersed in a 5-month bootcamp at Wild Code School, I am developing strong expertise in front-end development and UI design. My priority: creating interfaces that reduce cognitive friction and make digital experiences accessible to everyone. For me, accessibility isn't optional - it's the starting point.
about_block_strengths_text: My strength lies in front-end development. What sets me apart: systematically integrating project management, UX/UI design, and accessibility (A11Y) into every project. The result? Interfaces that perform, engage, and include. No compromises.
about_block_goal_text: Designing ergonomic, accessible, and high-performance user experiences by bridging UX cognitive patterns, accessibility (A11Y), and front-end development. In the long term, my goal is to build a borderless digital career, progressively moving toward coordination and project leadership roles.
about_block_funfact_text: I embrace my paradoxes: deaf yet a devoted cinephile, sedentary behind my code but ready to wander the UK or Ireland at the slightest opportunity. Between building PCs, creating disability-focused comics, and role-playing games, I turn every passion into a skill.
